llms_txt:
# MarginBird

> MarginBird (MarginBird LLC) is an international digital agency serving mostly US small businesses: creators, traders and experts, restaurants, med spas and home services. Its positioning is "Agencies sell tasks. We build business systems." It builds brand and design, websites, paid ads on Meta and Google, social content systems and automations, set up in the client's name so the client owns everything. It publishes its prices and offers a free business audit: a short video audit plus one fix you can use right away.

## Services

- [Brand and design](https://marginbird.netlify.app/services/brand-and-design): Brand identity and a locked template system so every post, page and ad stays on-brand. Brand starter kit $750 one-time, or included in Scale.
- [Websites](https://marginbird.netlify.app/services/websites): Premium websites live in 14 days, built to load in under two seconds and take bookings on their own.
- [Paid ads](https://marginbird.netlify.app/services/paid-ads): Meta and Google campaigns with working tracking and leads texted in under a minute. Ad spend is paid directly to the platform and never marked up.
- [Social growth](https://marginbird.netlify.app/services/social-growth): A content system that turns one recording into reels, carousels and stories, scheduled and answered.
- [Automation](https://marginbird.netlify.app/services/automation): Missed-call text-back, lead follow-up, review requests, reminders and rebooking, content automation, CRM and AI assistants.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://marginbird.netlify.app/pricing): Launch $997 once plus $149/mo care (month-to-month). Grow $997/mo plus $500 setup (3-month minimum). Scale $1,997/mo plus $500 setup, adds paid ads (3-month minimum; ad spend billed to the client).
- Paid ads: campaign launch $597; management $697/mo; launch and 3 months $2,197.
- Guarantees stated on the pricing page: site live in 14 days or the first month of care is free; ad campaigns live within 7 days of approval.
- [Free business audit](https://marginbird.netlify.app/free-audit): Free short video audit of brand, website, ads, social and tools, with one fix you can use right away.

## Company

- Legal name: MarginBird LLC
- Founders: Khandaker Ayman (Founder); Manjir Ahmed Bin Rouf Rahat (Co-founder & Chief Design Officer)
- Area served: United States
- Book a 30-minute call: https://calendly.com/aymankhak10/30min
- Founder's Fiverr gig (Instagram and Facebook management): https://www.fiverr.com/humanbeing489/do-professional-instagram-and-facebook-management

## Pages

- [Home](https://marginbird.netlify.app/): Overview of services, client results, process, pricing and the free audit.
- [Work](https://marginbird.netlify.app/work): Case studies, client websites and Instagram audiences run for clients.
- [Pricing](https://marginbird.netlify.app/pricing): Published plans, ads pricing, brand kit and guarantees.
- [Free audit](https://marginbird.netlify.app/free-audit): Request the free business audit.
- [Privacy Policy](https://marginbird.netlify.app/privacy): What MarginBird LLC collects through the website and why.
- [Terms of Service](https://marginbird.netlify.app/terms): Terms for using the website and working with MarginBird.
- [SMS Terms](https://marginbird.netlify.app/sms-terms): Terms for text messages sent by MarginBird and the texting systems it builds for clients.
